propDocs.Meter.value: Measurement to display; the fill clamps to the range.
propDocs.Meter.min: Lower end of the range, default 0.
propDocs.Meter.max: Upper end of the range, default 100.
propDocs.Meter.high: Styled-wrapper threshold above which the fill and value use the danger colour.
propDocs.Meter.format: Intl number options or a formatting function.
propDocs.Meter.locale: Number-formatting locale; omit for the page or browser locale.
